give.prompt: Break my CTC of ₹____ into real monthly in-hand (new tax regime FY 2025-26). List EVERY deduction step by step — variable pay held, employer PF, employee PF, gratuity, insurance, professional tax, then income tax slab by slab with cess. End with: which lines come back to me later, which never do, and the ONE line to negotiate in my next offer.
